instruction.text: Complete the sentence with the correct fraction.

trainers.finishSound: There is one quarter of the bread left.

atoms.a: Andy cuts the bread into four equal pieces. His dad and his sister eat one quarter each. He takes one piece for himself too. How much of the bread is left?
atoms.b: There is ((++one_quarter --two_quarters --one_third --nothing)) of the bread left.

instruction.text: Complete the sentence with the correct fraction.

trainers.finishSound: There is nothing left of the sandwich.

atoms.a: Charlotte and Noah cut a sandwich into two equal pieces. They each eat a half. How much of the sandwich is left?
atoms.b: There is ((--one_third --two_quarters --one_half ++nothing)) left of the sandwich.

instruction.text: Complete the sentence with the correct fraction.

trainers.finishSound: There are two thirds of the apple left.

atoms.a: Ellie cuts an apple into three equal pieces. She eats one of them. How much of the apple is left?
atoms.b: There are ((--one_third ++two_thirds --two_quarters --nothing)) of the apple left.

instruction.text: Complete the sentence with the correct fraction.

trainers.finishSound: There is one half of the bucket left for Julia.

atoms.a: Betty eats one half of the popcorn bucket. She leaves the rest for Julia. How much of the bucket is left for Julia?
atoms.b: There is ((--one_third ++one_half --one_quarter --nothing)) of the bucket left for Julia.

instruction.text: Complete the sentence with the correct fraction.

trainers.finishSound: There is nothing left for Frank.

atoms.a: Mom, Dad and Lori each eat a third of the pizza. How much is left for Frank?
